title: Leveraging Online Olympiad-Level Math Problems for LLMs Training and Contamination-Resistant Evaluation
authors_zh: Sadegh Mahdavi、Muchen Li、Kaiwen Liu、Christos Thrampoulidis、Leonid Sigal、Renjie Liao
paper_type_zh: 论坛数学 SFT 数据构造与时间评测配方
best_for_zh: 研究数学 SFT、动态基准、去污染、数据沿袭和社区内容发布审计的读者
one_line: AoPS-Instruct turns pre-2024 forum questions and community answers into 647,255 rewritten SFT pairs, while LiveAoPSBench applies stricter answer checks to newer timestamped posts.
AoPS-Instruct 将 2024 年前的论坛问题与社区解答转为 647,255 条重写 SFT 记录，LiveAoPSBench 则用更严格的答案检查筛选较新的时间戳帖子；训练快照、逐记录来源与内容复用权利仍不完整。
why: It exposes a scalable forum-distillation and temporal-evaluation recipe while showing why model-ready records still need immutable snapshots, source lineage, verifier audits, contributor attribution, and documented reuse rights.
inclusion_reason: Couples a large forum-to-SFT construction recipe with a timestamped evaluation recipe over the same source stream, making selection, answer checking, release versioning, community-content lineage, and contamination boundaries auditable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official ICML 2025 paper addresses two coupled bottlenecks in Olympiad-level mathematics. Large supervised fine-tuning corpora with worked solutions are expensive to author, while static public test sets may already be present in model training. The Art of Problem Solving (AoPS) forum supplies a continually growing stream of questions and community answers, but a forum topic is not a ready training or evaluation record: the first post may not ask a concrete problem, later posts may be irrelevant or incomplete, and different users may provide conflicting or terse solutions.

The paper turns the same source stream into two objects. AoPS-Instruct uses topics posted through 2023-12 and represents a retained example as a question paired with an LLM-rewritten community solution for SFT. LiveAoPSBench uses newer timestamps and represents an evaluation item as a question, rewritten solution, extracted final answer, and posting month. The paper starts from 1,076,712 topics, obtains 652K QA pairs after its general pipeline, and identifies 647,255 pre-2024-01 pairs as AoPS-Instruct; its main LiveAoPSBench-0824 snapshot contains 3,863 questions from 2024-01 through 2024-08 (Paper §3.1-§3.2, Appendix A.1).

This belongs in Data Construction and Open Release Recipes because the research object is the transformation from community discussions to selected, model-ready records: source roles, extraction, rewriting, overlap filtering, answer checks, timestamp splits, and release packaging all determine the final data. The Card does not treat downstream benchmark gains as proof that every rewritten rationale is correct, nor does it classify the final-answer checker as formal verification.

The release boundary is material. The authors release pipeline and evaluation code and link a 5,328-row full-2024 LiveAoPSBench snapshot. AoPS-Instruct is linked only as a community reproduction for which the authors disclaim liability. The default public training view contains two-message chats but no canonical topic/post identifiers; the benchmark view exposes five model-ready columns but no source URL. The paper therefore supports an auditable construction recipe and partial artifacts, not a complete author-maintained training release with resolved lineage and rights.

ICML 2025 官方论文同时处理奥赛数学中的两个相关瓶颈：带完整解答的大规模监督微调语料需要高昂的人工作者成本，而静态公开测试集又可能已经进入模型训练。Art of Problem Solving（AoPS）论坛持续产生问题和社区解答，但一个论坛 topic 并不是现成的训练或评测记录：首帖可能没有提出具体题目，后续帖子可能无关或不完整，不同用户还可能给出互相冲突或过于简略的解法。

论文把同一条来源流转成两种对象。AoPS-Instruct 使用截至 2023-12 发布的 topic，把保留样本表示为“问题 + 经 LLM 重写的社区解答”，用于 SFT；LiveAoPSBench 使用较新的时间戳，把评测项表示为问题、重写解答、抽取出的最终答案和发帖月份。论文从 1,076,712 个 topic 出发，经过通用流水线得到 652K 条 QA，其中 647,255 条 2024-01 以前的记录构成 AoPS-Instruct；主要的 LiveAoPSBench-0824 快照含 3,863 道 2024-01 至 2024-08 的题目（论文 §3.1-§3.2，附录 A.1）。

该工作属于 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes，因为研究对象正是社区讨论如何被转成经过筛选的模型就绪记录：来源角色、抽取、重写、重叠过滤、答案检查、时间划分和发布打包都会改变最终数据。本 Card 不把下游 benchmark 增益当成每条重写 rationale 都正确的证明，也不把最终答案 checker 归为形式验证。

发布边界同样关键。作者发布了流水线与评测代码，并链接一个含 5,328 行的完整 2024 年 LiveAoPSBench 快照；AoPS-Instruct 只以社区复现形式被链接，作者明确声明不对其承担责任。默认公开训练视图只有两条 chat message，没有规范 topic/post 标识；benchmark 视图有五个模型就绪字段，但没有来源 URL。因此，论文支持的是可审计的构造配方和部分 artifact，而不是具备完整沿袭、权利说明且由作者维护的训练数据发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central contribution is a shared forum-processing substrate whose selection contract changes between training and evaluation. For AoPS-Instruct, Qwen2.5-14B classifies whether the first post is a concrete math question; Llama-3.1-70B extracts that question and every answer-bearing later post, including answer user and post number; Qwen2.5-72B rewrites each selected answer into formal steps; and exact 10-gram matching removes overlaps with listed math test sets. Multiple valid replies to one topic can become multiple SFT pairs (Paper Figure 2, §3.1, Appendix G).

LiveAoPSBench keeps recent topics but adds an answerability contract. It excludes proof questions and candidates without a boxed final answer, applies stricter 8-gram matching, and rewrites each item independently with Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct. Final answers must agree under text equality, numeric equality, or SymPy equivalence; disagreements are removed and remaining answers are deduplicated. The stack can observe timestamps, extractable terminal answers, and cross-model agreement. It cannot establish that an intermediate derivation is valid, that two models did not share an error, or that a paraphrased older problem is uncontaminated.

Three artifacts must remain distinct. The paper's AoPS-Instruct is a 647,255-pair pre-2024 training corpus; the paper's LiveAoPSBench-0824 is a 3,863-question January-August 2024 evaluation snapshot; and the checked full-year LiveAoPSBench-2024 release has 5,328 rows at HF revision 3ff6280f4c1d75a035698524c26ee91c70e4e2b5. The linked AoPS-Instruct download is a third-party reproduction at a separate HF revision. Matching row counts do not make those releases one verified dataset.

Numina and Omni-MATH already used AoPS-derived material, while LiveCodeBench supplied the timestamped-evaluation precedent in code. The concrete difference here is to crawl the broader forum rather than only contest collections, preserve posting time as a selection variable, and use the same incoming stream for SFT and a stricter live evaluation protocol. The live property is therefore a versioned procedure, not a permanent guarantee: once a snapshot is public, future post-training can absorb it.

核心贡献是复用同一个论坛处理底座，但让训练与评测采用不同的筛选契约。对 AoPS-Instruct，Qwen2.5-14B 判断首帖是否提出具体数学问题；Llama-3.1-70B 抽取该问题及所有包含答案的后续帖子，同时记录答题用户和帖子编号；Qwen2.5-72B 把每条入选答案重写为正式步骤；最后用精确 10-gram 匹配删除与已列出数学测试集重叠的记录。同一 topic 中的多条有效回复可以形成多组 SFT 样本（论文 Figure 2、§3.1、附录 G）。

LiveAoPSBench 保留近期 topic，但增加可回答性契约。它排除证明题和没有 boxed final answer 的候选，使用更严格的 8-gram 匹配，并让 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 独立重写每个样本。最终答案必须在文本相等、数值相等或 SymPy 等价规则下达成一致；不一致项被删除，剩余答案再去重。这套系统能观察时间戳、可抽取终局答案和跨模型一致性，却不能证明中间推导有效、两个模型没有共享同一错误，或改写后的旧题没有污染。

必须区分三种 artifact。论文中的 AoPS-Instruct 是含 647,255 条记录的 2024 年前训练语料；论文中的 LiveAoPSBench-0824 是含 3,863 道题的 2024 年一月至八月评测快照；本次检查的完整年度 LiveAoPSBench-2024 在 HF revision 3ff6280f4c1d75a035698524c26ee91c70e4e2b5 上有 5,328 行。链接的 AoPS-Instruct 下载则是位于另一个 HF revision 的第三方复现。行数一致不能把这些发布合并成一个已经核实的数据集。

Numina 与 Omni-MATH 已使用 AoPS 衍生材料，LiveCodeBench 则在代码领域提供了时间戳评测先例。本文的具体差别是采集更广的论坛内容而非只用竞赛题集，把发帖时间设为筛选变量，并让同一条持续流入的数据同时支持 SFT 与更严格的 live 评测协议。因此，live 是一个需要版本化的流程，而不是永久保证：快照一旦公开，未来的后训练就可能吸收它。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are complete AoPS topics with a first-post timestamp and ordered user posts. The crawl contains 1,076,712 topics. Qwen2.5-14B classifies the first post with a few-shot binary prompt, leaving 478,337 math-question topics after 598,375 are pruned. Llama-3.1-70B then reads the numbered conversation and returns the first-post question plus every answer user's identity and post number. A repository sanity check confirms that the returned user matches the selected post. Qwen2.5-72B receives the question and raw answer and is instructed to formalize only the supplied solution without adding information. Exact 10-gram matching against listed evaluation sets produces 652K QA pairs, 647,255 of them dated before January 2024 (Paper §3.1; Appendix G; official repository parse_aops.py).

For LiveAoPSBench-0824, the timestamp window initially contains 14,158 QA pairs. 8-gram matching against MATH and GSM8K training sets removes 664. Excluding proof questions and non-boxed solutions leaves 7,173 pairs over 5,416 unique questions. Independent Llama and Qwen rewrites then undergo final-answer agreement checks; 1,553 inconsistent questions are removed, yielding 3,863. The same procedure yields 5,216 questions for the 2023 retrospective split. The full-2024 release later grows to 5,328 rows (Paper Appendix A.1 and B.1).

The supervision attaches to the whole answer. For SFT, the question is the instruction and the Qwen-rewritten solution is the response under each model's chat template. The paper trains DeepSeekMath-7B-Instruct, Mathstral-7B, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, and Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct for three epochs on full AoPS-Instruct, Numina, or their mixture, then evaluates on LiveAoPSBench, MATH, a 675-item text/final-answer OlympiadBench subset, and 4,428 Omni-MATH problems. It does not construct step labels, a process reward, or an RLVR objective. Optimizer, batch size, learning rate, seeds, and exact model revisions are undisclosed.

The checked public benchmark row has question, month-level post_time, rewritten solution, answer, and idx. The third-party AoPS-Instruct default row is a two-message messages list. Neither default model-ready view exposes the internal topic ID, answer post number, or canonical source URL described by the extraction prompts. The third-party 2024_not_decontaminated configuration preserves original/rewrite fields and hashed user metadata, but it is not the pre-2024 decontaminated training set.

Reproduction must pin at least the paper version, repository commit 56f6bc1e670170e301f1c9ebc172124defd21e90, both HF revisions, crawl cutoff, model checkpoints, prompts, decoding, retry policy, overlap inventory, answer-normalization code, and output manifest. Current gaps require explicit handling: Figure 2 labels QA extraction as Qwen 32B whereas the text and parse_aops.py specify Llama-3.1-70B; the paper uses Qwen2.5-14B for topic classification whereas current classify_aops.py defaults to Llama-3.1-8B; and the repository tree lacks the scripts/crawl_raw.sh and scripts/reproduce.sh files invoked by its README.

输入是带首帖时间戳和有序用户帖子的完整 AoPS topic。原始采集含 1,076,712 个 topic。Qwen2.5-14B 用 few-shot 二分类提示判断首帖，删除 598,375 个 topic 后留下 478,337 个数学问题 topic。随后，Llama-3.1-70B 阅读带编号的对话，返回首帖问题以及每个答案用户的身份与帖子编号；仓库中的 sanity check 会确认返回用户与被选帖子一致。Qwen2.5-72B 接收问题和原始答案，只被允许形式化给定解答，不能增加信息。针对已列出评测集做精确 10-gram 匹配后得到 652K 条 QA，其中 647,255 条早于 2024 年 1 月（论文 §3.1、附录 G；官方仓库 parse_aops.py）。

对 LiveAoPSBench-0824，时间窗口最初包含 14,158 条 QA。针对 MATH 与 GSM8K 训练集做 8-gram 匹配后删除 664 条；排除证明题和没有 boxed solution 的样本后，剩下 7,173 条 QA，覆盖 5,416 道唯一题目。Llama 与 Qwen 独立重写的最终答案再接受一致性检查，1,553 道不一致题被删除，最终得到 3,863 道。相同流程在 2023 年数据上得到 5,216 道回顾性 split；后续完整 2024 年发布增长到 5,328 行（论文附录 A.1 与 B.1）。

监督信号附着在完整答案上。SFT 时，问题作为 instruction，Qwen 重写解答作为 response，并套用各模型的 chat template。论文对 DeepSeekMath-7B-Instruct、Mathstral-7B、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 与 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 训练三轮，数据分别是完整 AoPS-Instruct、Numina 或两者混合；随后在 LiveAoPSBench、MATH、OlympiadBench 中 675 道文本且有最终答案的子集，以及 4,428 道 Omni-MATH 上评测。它没有构造步骤标签、process reward 或 RLVR 目标。optimizer、batch size、learning rate、随机种子和精确模型 revision 均未披露。

本次检查的公开 benchmark 记录包含 question、月粒度 post_time、重写 solution、answer 与 idx。第三方 AoPS-Instruct 默认记录则是两条 messages。这两个默认模型就绪视图都没有暴露抽取提示中描述的内部 topic ID、答案帖子编号或规范来源 URL。第三方 2024_not_decontaminated 配置保留原始/重写字段和哈希用户元数据，但它并不是 2024 年前、已去污染的训练集。

复现至少要固定论文版本、仓库 commit 56f6bc1e670170e301f1c9ebc172124defd21e90、两个 HF revision、爬取 cutoff、模型 checkpoint、提示词、解码、重试策略、重叠清单、答案规范化代码和输出 manifest。目前的缺口必须显式处理：Figure 2 把 QA 抽取标为 Qwen 32B，而正文与 parse_aops.py 指向 Llama-3.1-70B；论文用 Qwen2.5-14B 做 topic 分类，而当前 classify_aops.py 默认使用 Llama-3.1-8B；仓库树中也不存在 README 调用的 scripts/crawl_raw.sh 和 scripts/reproduce.sh。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest direct quality check is narrow but concrete. Ten graduate students annotate a random 10% of LiveAoPSBench-0824 (386 questions), with two annotators per question referring to the raw post. Across annotations, 92% are marked correct, 5% incorrect, and 3% no-answer. Appendix A.2 shows that even human annotators disagree when the raw post states an answer indirectly. This supports final-answer utility for the sampled benchmark subset; it does not validate every rationale, the 647,255 training pairs, or the release's source rights (Paper §3.2, §4.5, Appendix A.2).

The SFT experiments show that the constructed records change tested models. On LiveAoPSBench/MATH/OlympiadBench/Omni-MATH, DeepSeekMath-7B-Instruct moves from 11.7/47.1/14.5/12.3 without SFT to 19.0/58.8/24.3/17.8 with AoPS-Instruct. Mathstral-7B moves from 15.4/56.3/21.2/15.9 to 23.6/60.8/27.1/19.9. Llama-3.2-3B and 1B also improve in the reported AoPS-only rows. These are author-reported, three-epoch SFT results, not an independent reproduction and not a record-level correctness audit (Paper Table 3).

The result is not uniformly monotonic. Adding Numina to AoPS improves many rows, but Mathstral's MATH score is 59.6 for the mixture versus 60.8 for AoPS alone, and Appendix Table 8 includes several AIME24/AMC23 ties or regressions. In the rewrite ablation, Qwen rewriting is strongest on MATH, AMC23, and OlympiadBench, but its GSM8K score is 79.2 versus 81.1 for Llama rewriting. This makes the evidence conditional on model, benchmark, mixture, and rewrite policy rather than a general data-quality guarantee (Paper Figure 5b, Tables 3 and 8).

Timestamp evidence is also correlational. Exact 10-gram overlap with Numina decreases across the five four-month windows from 13.24% to 11.65%, 12.82%, 9.92%, and 6.88%, and evaluated models score lower on 2024 than 2023 questions. Newer timestamps reduce direct exposure opportunities, but changing difficulty, topic mix, answer type, and model cutoff can also affect scores; substring matching misses paraphrases (Paper Table 2, Figure 1).

Artifacts corroborate object shape and size: the checked LiveAoPSBench release has 5,328 test rows with five fields, and the third-party AoPS-Instruct default configuration has exactly 647,255 train rows with a two-message schema. The paper's own Figures 16 and 17 document an incomplete rewrite and a counting error. Release counts and downstream gains therefore support the pipeline's usefulness, while the failure examples prevent interpreting the benchmark results as proof that every selected reasoning trace is correct.

最直接的质量检查范围有限，但足够具体。10 名研究生对 LiveAoPSBench-0824 随机 10% 的样本（386 道题）做标注，每题由两人参照原始帖子判断。全部标注中，92% 被判为正确，5% 错误，3% 属于 no-answer。附录 A.2 还展示了原帖以间接方式给出答案时的人类分歧。这支持被抽样 benchmark 子集的最终答案效用，但不能验证每条 rationale、647,255 条训练记录或发布的来源权利（论文 §3.2、§4.5、附录 A.2）。

SFT 实验说明构造记录会改变被测模型。在 LiveAoPSBench/MATH/OlympiadBench/Omni-MATH 上，DeepSeekMath-7B-Instruct 从未做 SFT 时的 11.7/47.1/14.5/12.3 变为使用 AoPS-Instruct 后的 19.0/58.8/24.3/17.8；Mathstral-7B 从 15.4/56.3/21.2/15.9 变为 23.6/60.8/27.1/19.9。Llama-3.2-3B 与 1B 在论文报告的 AoPS-only 行中也有提升。这些是作者报告的三轮 SFT 结果，不是独立复现，也不是逐记录正确性审计（论文 Table 3）。

结果并非处处单调。把 Numina 加入 AoPS 会改善很多行，但 Mathstral 在 MATH 上的混合数据分数为 59.6，低于只用 AoPS 的 60.8；附录 Table 8 中多个 AIME24/AMC23 结果也出现持平或回退。重写消融中，Qwen 在 MATH、AMC23 和 OlympiadBench 上最强，但其 GSM8K 分数为 79.2，低于 Llama 重写的 81.1。因此，这些证据依赖模型、benchmark、数据混合与重写策略，不能上升为一般性数据质量保证（论文 Figure 5b、Tables 3 与 8）。

时间戳证据同样只是相关关系。与 Numina 的精确 10-gram 重叠率在五个连续四个月窗口中依次为 13.24%、11.65%、12.82%、9.92% 和 6.88%，被测模型在 2024 年题目上的分数也低于 2023 年。较新时间戳减少了直接暴露机会，但难度、主题混合、答案类型和模型 cutoff 的变化也会影响分数；substring matching 还无法发现改写题（论文 Table 2、Figure 1）。

artifact 核实了对象形态与规模：本次检查的 LiveAoPSBench 发布有 5,328 行 test 数据和五个字段，第三方 AoPS-Instruct 默认配置则恰有 647,255 行 train 数据及两条 message 的 schema。论文自己的 Figures 16 与 17 还记录了一个不完整重写和一个计数错误。因此，发布计数与下游增益支持流水线的实用性，而这些失败样例阻止我们把 benchmark 结果解释为每条入选推理轨迹都正确的证明。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier mathematical instruction collections already used competition problems, community solutions, LLM generation, or solution rewriting. Numina includes about 30K questions from the AoPS contest collection, and Omni-MATH uses 4,428 AoPS-derived evaluation questions across timestamps. LiveCodeBench had already demonstrated timestamp-based rolling evaluation in code. AoPS-Instruct and LiveAoPSBench therefore do not introduce LLM rewriting, substring decontamination, or live evaluation in isolation.

The concrete change is to make a broad community forum one shared, continuously growing substrate for both training and evaluation. The training path separates the first-post question, a selected later user's source answer, and a Qwen-authored rewrite; the evaluation path adds a timestamp cutoff, proof/non-answer exclusions, a lower n-gram threshold, two independent rewrites, final-answer agreement, and human sampling. Posting time and source role become construction fields rather than incidental metadata.

The work also distinguishes training selection from evaluation selection. Proof questions remain eligible for AoPS-Instruct but are excluded from LiveAoPSBench because the judge observes only parseable terminal answers. One incoming discussion can yield several SFT pairs when multiple replies contain solutions, whereas the benchmark deduplicates final-answer candidates. This makes data-object semantics and feedback observability explicit instead of treating all forum text as one homogeneous corpus.

Some of the contribution is scale and engineering: 1.07M crawled topics, staged open-model inference, exact-match filters, and evolving publication. The directional contribution for reasoning-data research is the coupled protocol: a source timestamp can define a training cutoff and a later evaluation window, while separate filters reflect different reuse risks. That protocol remains valid only when every snapshot and model cutoff is pinned.

Before reuse, researchers must still verify which artifact is author-maintained, whether Figure 2 or the body/code identifies the actual extraction model, whether the public files preserve enough lineage for correction and attribution, and whether a future model could have trained on the released benchmark. Those checks distinguish the methodological contribution from unsupported claims of permanent contamination resistance.

更早的数学 instruction 数据已经使用竞赛题、社区解答、LLM 生成或解答重写。Numina 从 AoPS 竞赛题集中收录约 30K 道问题，Omni-MATH 则使用跨时间的 4,428 道 AoPS 衍生评测题；LiveCodeBench 也已在代码领域展示基于时间戳的滚动评测。因此，AoPS-Instruct 与 LiveAoPSBench 并不是分别首次引入 LLM 重写、substring 去污染或 live 评测。

具体变化是把一个覆盖面更广、持续增长的社区论坛设为训练与评测共享的底座。训练路径区分首帖问题、某位后续用户的源答案和 Qwen 撰写的重写；评测路径则增加时间 cutoff、证明题/无答案排除、更低的 n-gram 阈值、两次独立重写、最终答案一致性与人工抽样。发帖时间与来源角色由附带信息变成构造字段。

该工作还区分训练筛选和评测筛选。证明题仍可进入 AoPS-Instruct，却被 LiveAoPSBench 排除，因为 judge 只能观察可解析的终局答案；当多条回复都包含解法时，一个新讨论可以产生多组 SFT 样本，而 benchmark 会对最终答案候选去重。这样，data-object 语义与反馈可观测性被明确表达，不再把所有论坛文本视为同质语料。

贡献的一部分确实来自规模与工程整合：1.07M 个被采集 topic、分阶段开源模型推理、精确匹配过滤和演化式发布。对 reasoning-data 研究更有方向意义的是耦合协议：来源时间戳可以同时定义训练 cutoff 与后续评测窗口，不同过滤器则对应不同复用风险。只有固定每个快照和模型 cutoff 后，这一协议才成立。

复用前仍需确认哪些 artifact 由作者维护、Figure 2 与正文/代码中哪个抽取模型才是实际配置、公开文件是否保留足够沿袭以支持纠错和署名，以及未来模型是否可能已经训练过公开 benchmark。这些检查把方法贡献与“永久抗污染”之类缺乏支持的主张区分开来。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The verifier stack is answer-level and fallible. Community responses can be incomplete or wrong; the extractor can select the wrong reply; and rewriting can add, omit, or distort a step despite a prompt that forbids adding information. Cross-model agreement preserves shared errors and compares final answers rather than proofs. The paper itself shows an incomplete cubic solution and an incorrect counting rewrite, so a correct benchmark score cannot certify the training rationales (Paper Figures 16-17).

Coverage is structurally limited. LiveAoPSBench removes proof questions and items without concrete boxed answers, while the source processing is text-only. This excludes an important part of Olympiad reasoning and underrepresents diagram-dependent geometry. The human audit covers 386 benchmark questions, not the full benchmark and not 647,255 training pairs; its 5% incorrect and 3% no-answer annotations also show residual selection/judge error.

Reproduction is incomplete at the checked versions. The author repository has no tagged release, and commit 56f6bc1e670170e301f1c9ebc172124defd21e90 lacks the two shell scripts invoked by its README. Figure 2 labels QA extraction as Qwen 32B, while the body and current parse_aops.py specify Llama-3.1-70B; the paper's Qwen2.5-14B topic classifier also differs from current classify_aops.py's Llama-3.1-8B default. Paper-run decoding, retries, seeds, optimizer, and full environment are unknown. The public AoPS-Instruct artifact is explicitly third-party; equal row counts do not demonstrate identical crawl dates, source edits, model versions, filters, or records.

Public provenance is insufficient for source-level audit. The extraction prompt records answer user and post number, but the default model-ready releases omit canonical topic/post URLs and IDs. The benchmark exposes an index, and the third-party default training set exposes only chat messages. Curator inference: this weakens independent source verification, contributor credit, targeted correction, and takedown handling even if identifiers were omitted for privacy. A protected provenance map could address those needs, but none was verified.

Content-rights evidence is unresolved. AoPS terms say AoPS does not claim ownership of submitted content and that users grant AoPS a broad sublicensable license. The reviewed paper, repository, and dataset cards do not document a corresponding authorization from AoPS or contributors to the dataset publisher. Curator inference: Apache-2.0/MIT labels on code or uploads do not by themselves establish rights in underlying user solutions or reposted problem statements. This is an audit gap, not a conclusion that a release is unlawful.

Timestamp splitting lowers but does not eliminate contamination. Reposted or paraphrased old problems can appear after the cutoff, and 8/10-gram filters miss semantic overlap. The 2023 retrospective split falls inside the AoPS-Instruct source period and is not automatically held out for an AoPS-trained model. LiveAoPSBench-0824 and the current 5,328-row full-2024 release are different snapshots; an unpinned LiveAoPSBench-2024 score is not reproducible, and a public snapshot can enter future training.

验证器堆栈只检查答案级信号，而且可能出错。社区回复可能不完整或错误，抽取器可能选错帖子，重写器也可能在提示明确禁止增加信息时添加、遗漏或扭曲步骤。跨模型一致性会保留共享错误，并且比较的是最终答案而非证明。论文自己展示了一个不完整的三次方程解答和一个计数错误的重写，因此正确的 benchmark 分数不能认证训练 rationale（论文 Figures 16-17）。

覆盖范围有结构性限制。LiveAoPSBench 删除证明题和没有明确 boxed answer 的样本，来源处理又只支持文本。这排除了奥赛推理中的重要部分，也低估了依赖图示的几何题。人工审计只覆盖 386 道 benchmark 题目，既不是完整 benchmark，也不是 647,255 条训练记录；其中 5% 错误、3% no-answer 的标注也说明仍有筛选/judge 误差。

在本次检查的版本上，复现仍不完整。作者仓库没有 tagged release，commit 56f6bc1e670170e301f1c9ebc172124defd21e90 也缺少 README 调用的两个 shell 脚本。Figure 2 把 QA 抽取标为 Qwen 32B，而正文和当前 parse_aops.py 指向 Llama-3.1-70B；论文中的 Qwen2.5-14B topic classifier 也不同于当前 classify_aops.py 默认的 Llama-3.1-8B。论文运行的解码、重试、随机种子、optimizer 和完整环境均未知。公开 AoPS-Instruct artifact 被明确标为第三方；行数相等不能证明爬取日期、源帖编辑、模型版本、过滤器或逐条记录相同。

公开 provenance 不足以支持来源级审计。抽取提示会记录答案用户和帖子编号，但默认模型就绪发布省略了规范 topic/post URL 与 ID；benchmark 只暴露索引，第三方默认训练集也只有 chat message。Curator inference：即使这些标识是出于隐私而省略，这仍会削弱独立来源核验、贡献者署名、定向纠错和 takedown 处理。受保护的 provenance map 可以兼顾这些需求，但本次没有核实到此类机制。

内容权利证据仍未解决。AoPS 条款说明 AoPS 不主张用户提交内容的所有权，用户则向 AoPS 授予广泛、可再许可的许可。已检查的论文、仓库和数据卡没有记录 AoPS 或贡献者向数据集发布者提供的对应授权。Curator inference：代码或上传页面上的 Apache-2.0/MIT 标签本身不能证明对底层用户解答或转载题目的权利。这是审计缺口，并不等于认定发布违法。

时间划分只能降低、不能消除污染。旧题的转载或改写可能在 cutoff 后出现，8/10-gram 过滤也会漏掉语义重叠。2023 回顾性 split 落在 AoPS-Instruct 来源时期内，对 AoPS 训练模型并不自动构成留出集。LiveAoPSBench-0824 与当前 5,328 行的完整 2024 发布是不同快照；不固定版本的 LiveAoPSBench-2024 分数无法复现，公开快照也可能进入未来训练。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, this paper is a worked example of turning one evolving community source into two different reasoning-data products. A controlled replication can hold the crawl and extraction stages fixed, then compare training selection (10-gram decontamination, proofs allowed) with evaluation selection (timestamp window, 8-gram filtering, concrete boxed answers, dual rewrites, answer agreement). This makes source, behavior, feedback, selection, and audit separable experimental variables.

A reusable training record should retain a stable topic ID, canonical thread URL, first-post ID and timestamp, selected answer-post ID, a privacy-preserving contributor reference, raw question, raw answer, rewritten solution, model and prompt revisions, decoding/retry settings, every filter decision, and source-edit/deletion status. The model-ready view can omit sensitive fields, but a release steward still needs a protected lineage table for correction, attribution, and takedown. A license label should be tied to each source class rather than inferred from the code license.

A reusable live benchmark should bind an immutable snapshot ID and HF commit to exact first/last post dates, source IDs, overlap inventories, answer-normalization code, rewrite-model revisions, rejected disagreements, human-audit sample, and scoring-code version. Evaluators should report the tested model checkpoint, known pretraining/post-training cutoff, evaluation date, and whether that benchmark snapshot was public during training. The 2023 retrospective split, LiveAoPSBench-0824, and the full-2024 release should be named separately.

The paper also supports concrete audit experiments. Re-run extraction on a stratified set of topics and compare selected post IDs; compare Qwen and Llama rewrites with symbolic and expert process checks; measure false accepts/false rejects for string, numeric, and SymPy comparison; test semantic rather than only n-gram overlap; and publish stage-by-stage counts plus accepted and rejected manifests. These studies directly evaluate the feedback and selection contract instead of treating downstream accuracy as a proxy for trace correctness.

Reuse class: currently suitable as a construction, audit, and replication reference. The pinned LiveAoPSBench artifact can support guarded evaluation after checking its terms and the model's cutoff. Training reuse of the linked AoPS-Instruct file is blocked pending author-maintained equivalence, source-level provenance, rights/attribution review, and immutable manifests. The paper supports sft as the demonstrated training use, but does not support RLVR, reward-model, or process-supervision claims.

对 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track 而言，这篇论文完整展示了如何把一个持续演化的社区来源转成两种不同的 reasoning-data 产品。受控复现可以固定爬取与抽取阶段，只比较训练筛选（10-gram 去污染、允许证明题）和评测筛选（时间窗口、8-gram 过滤、明确 boxed answer、双重写与答案一致性）。这样，source、behavior、feedback、selection 与 audit 可以成为彼此分离的实验变量。

可复用训练记录应保留稳定 topic ID、规范 thread URL、首帖 ID 与时间戳、被选答案帖 ID、隐私保护的贡献者引用、原始问题、原始答案、重写解答、模型与提示词 revision、解码/重试设置、每项过滤决策，以及源帖编辑/删除状态。模型就绪视图可以省略敏感字段，但发布维护者仍需保存受保护的 lineage table，用于纠错、署名和 takedown。许可证标签也应绑定到每种来源，而不是从代码许可证推断。

可复用 live benchmark 应把不可变 snapshot ID 与 HF commit 绑定到精确首尾发帖日期、来源 ID、重叠清单、答案规范化代码、重写模型 revision、被拒分歧、人工审计样本和评分代码版本。评测者应报告被测模型 checkpoint、已知预训练/后训练 cutoff、评测日期，以及该 benchmark 快照在训练时是否已经公开。2023 回顾性 split、LiveAoPSBench-0824 与完整 2024 发布必须分别命名。

论文还支持具体审计实验：在分层 topic 样本上重跑抽取并比较被选帖子 ID；用符号工具和专家过程检查比较 Qwen/Llama 重写；测量文本、数值与 SymPy 比较的假接受/假拒绝；测试语义重叠而不只做 n-gram 匹配；并发布逐阶段计数及已接受/被拒 manifest。这些研究会直接评估反馈与筛选契约，而不是用下游准确率替代轨迹正确性。

复用等级：当前适合作为构造、审计和复现参考。固定 revision 的 LiveAoPSBench 在检查使用条款与模型 cutoff 后，可谨慎用于评测。链接的 AoPS-Instruct 文件在获得作者维护的等价性证明、来源级 provenance、权利/署名审查和不可变 manifest 前，不应直接用于训练。论文只支持已演示的 sft 训练用途，不支持扩张为 RLVR、reward model 或 process supervision。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Separate the artifacts: the authors maintain pipeline/evaluation code, officially link LiveAoPSBench, and label AoPS-Instruct as a third-party community reproduction with a liability disclaimer.
  • Keep the paper snapshots distinct: 647,255 pre-2024 SFT pairs, 3,863 January-August 2024 benchmark questions, 5,216 retrospective 2023 questions, and 5,328 full-2024 HF rows.
  • Read §3.1-§3.2 with Appendix A.1 and Appendix G: the source roles, 10/8-gram rules, dual rewrites, and answer agreement define the data more precisely than the abstract.
  • The 92% correct annotation rate covers a 386-question benchmark sample; it does not validate the 647,255 training rationales, and the paper publishes concrete rewrite failures.
  • Resolve reproduction gaps before rerunning: Figure 2's Qwen-32B extraction label conflicts with the text/code's Llama-3.1-70B, current classifier defaults differ from the paper, and the checked repository lacks the README-referenced shell scripts.
  • Pin source IDs, commits, post windows, model revisions, filter manifests, content-rights records, attribution, and deletion/takedown procedures before training or reporting a live score.

• 必须区分这些 artifact：作者维护流水线/评测代码，正式链接 LiveAoPSBench，并把 AoPS-Instruct 标为带免责说明的第三方社区复现。
  • 不要混合论文中的不同快照：647,255 条 2024 年前 SFT 记录、3,863 道 2024 年 1-8 月 benchmark 题、5,216 道 2023 回顾性题目，以及 HF 上 5,328 行的完整 2024 发布。
  • 将 §3.1-§3.2 与附录 A.1、附录 G 对照阅读：来源角色、10/8-gram 规则、双重写与答案一致性比摘要更准确地定义数据。
  • 92% 正确率只覆盖 386 道 benchmark 抽样题，不能验证 647,255 条训练 rationale；论文还公开了具体重写失败。
  • 重跑前先解决复现缺口：Figure 2 的 Qwen-32B 抽取标注与正文/代码中的 Llama-3.1-70B 冲突，当前 classifier 默认值也不同于论文，而且本次检查的仓库缺少 README 引用的 shell 脚本。
  • 训练或报告 live 分数前，应固定来源 ID、commit、帖子时间窗、模型 revision、过滤清单、内容权利记录、署名和删除/takedown 流程。

value.html: AoPS forum topics: the first post supplies a candidate mathematical question, and later posts in the same thread supply candidate community answers.

The model-ready AoPS-Instruct view is a two-message user/assistant record containing a question and rewritten solution. The checked LiveAoPSBench-2024 release contains question, month-level post_time, rewritten solution, extracted answer, and integer idx.

Community members write the source answers; Llama-3.1-70B identifies answer-bearing posts and Qwen2.5-72B rewrites selected answers into formal step-by-step solutions. LiveAoPSBench additionally compares independent Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct rewrites.

value.html: An offline crawl of public AoPS forum discussions followed by LLM classification, conversation parsing, solution rewriting, substring filtering, answer normalization, and dataset packaging; there is no interactive training environment.

Qwen2.5-14B filters non-math first posts; Llama-3.1-70B extracts questions and answer posts; 10-gram or 8-gram exact overlap rules filter records. For the live benchmark, boxed-answer heuristics and independent Llama/Qwen rewrites are checked by string equality, numeric equality, or SymPy equivalence. A 386-item human sample checks final answers against raw posts. No scalar reward or formal proof verifier is used.

A training QA pair survives question detection, answer extraction, rewriting, and 10-gram benchmark decontamination. A live benchmark question also survives timestamp selection, 8-gram filtering, proof/non-boxed-answer exclusion, deduplication, and agreement between two rewritten final answers.
Downstream SFT starts from DeepSeekMath-7B-Instruct, Mathstral-7B, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, or Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct in the reported experiments.

Qwen2.5-14B for math-question classification, Llama-3.1-70B for question/answer extraction, and Qwen2.5-72B for training-solution rewriting; LiveAoPSBench uses Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct for independent rewrites.
AoPS crawler plus a staged LLM parsing and rewriting pipeline. Multiple valid answer posts in one topic can yield multiple QA pairs.

Crawl topics, classify the first post, parse the full discussion, select every answer-bearing later post with user/post provenance, rewrite each selected answer, separate records by first-post timestamp, then apply task-specific overlap and answer filters.
unknown
unknown

Reject non-math topics and topics without answer-bearing replies; decontaminate AoPS-Instruct with exact 10-gram matching against listed math test sets. For LiveAoPSBench, apply 8-gram matching against MATH and GSM8K training data, exclude proof questions and non-boxed answers, remove inconsistent dual-model answers, and deduplicate candidates.

The paper does not disclose total generation tokens or wall-clock cost. The official reproduction README states a default setup of four 80GB A100 GPUs and a minimum of two 80GB A100/H100 GPUs for parsing, but this is not a measured paper-run budget.

Each reported SFT run uses the question as instruction, the rewritten solution as response, the model-specific chat template, and three epochs. Optimizer, learning rate, batch size, seeds, and exact checkpoint revisions are not disclosed in the paper.

The crawl covers all available AoPS forum topics rather than only contest collections. Topics through December 2023 feed AoPS-Instruct; later records feed timestamped evaluation snapshots. Exact topic-category proportions and an immutable source manifest are not released.

The paper reports 647,255 pre-January-2024 AoPS-Instruct QA pairs and a LiveAoPSBench-0824 snapshot of 3,863 questions from January-August 2024. It also builds a 5,216-question 2023 retrospective split whose dates overlap the AoPS-Instruct source window. The checked full-year HF benchmark revision has 5,328 test rows.

AoPS-Instruct uses exact 10-gram matching against a listed set of math test datasets. LiveAoPSBench-0824 uses exact 8-gram matching against MATH and GSM8K training data. Exact matching cannot detect all paraphrases, reposted problems, or shared mathematical templates.

items: LLM extraction can select an irrelevant or incomplete reply, and rewriting can introduce or preserve mathematical errors despite instructions not to add information; the paper includes incomplete and incorrect rewrite examples.
Dual-model final-answer agreement can preserve a shared error and does not verify intermediate reasoning or a proof.
The human audit covers 386 benchmark questions, not the 647,255 training records; 5% of annotations were incorrect and 3% were no-answer.
Proof questions and diagram-dependent problems are not supported by the live evaluation contract, biasing it toward text-only, parseable final answers.
The 2023 retrospective benchmark lies inside the AoPS-Instruct source period and is not automatically a clean held-out test for an AoPS-Instruct-trained model.
Current model-ready releases omit canonical topic/post URLs and contributor attribution, weakening record-level source verification, correction, credit, and takedown handling.
The author repository links AoPS-Instruct only as a community reproduction and disclaims liability; row-count agreement does not establish record-level equivalence to the paper corpus.
At checked commit 56f6bc1e670170e301f1c9ebc172124defd21e90, README commands reference scripts/crawl_raw.sh and scripts/reproduce.sh, but the scripts directory is absent from the repository tree.

Paper Figure 2 labels QA extraction as Qwen 32B, while the body and current parse_aops.py identify Llama-3.1-70B. The paper uses Qwen2.5-14B for topic classification, while current classify_aops.py defaults to Llama-3.1-8B. Exact paper-run configuration must be resolved before reproduction.
An evolving public benchmark becomes available to future training runs; an evaluation must pin the HF revision, post-date window, model checkpoint, training cutoff, and evaluation date.

AoPS terms say AoPS does not claim ownership of user submissions and that users grant AoPS a broad sublicensable license. No reviewed artifact documents the dataset publisher's source-content license or contributor-attribution arrangement; this is an unresolved rights audit, not a legal conclusion.

AoPS topic and first-post timestamp -> first-post question plus selected later answer user/post -> LLM rewrite -> overlap and answer filters -> SFT or timestamped evaluation record. Internal prompts retain user/post references, but the model-ready default public views do not expose canonical thread URLs or topic/post IDs.
